summary: ASUR's subsidiary Aeropuerto de Cancún completed a Rule 144A/Reg S offering of $900M 6.711% senior notes due 2031 and $900M 7.491% senior notes due 2036, settling October 8, 2026, rated BBB/BBB+ by S&P and Fitch. Proceeds repay a Ps.6,390M bridge facility (December 2025) tied to the ASUR US Commercial Airports acquisition and a $1,299M bridge facility (August 14, 2026) tied to the Companhia de Participações em Concessões acquisition, with the remainder for other liabilities. Notes are expected listed on SGX-ST and were not registered under the Securities Act. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation; watch for deleveraging and integration of the acquired airport assets.
